steps: As an existing DANO Energy customer, log into your account and click 'Refer Your Friends'.
Refer your friend; they place an order with DANO Energy.
After your friend receives their first delivery, a $50 credit is applied to your account.
The friend receives a $30 credit toward their own deliveries.
